title: Initial app starter with idea-capture flow

requirements.text: Create a simple landing page that helps the user describe what app they want to build, including a short guided form (e.g., app name, what it should do, target users, must-have features, nice-to-have features) and a submit action that shows a confirmation summary on screen.

quotes: Hello can you help me make a app

acceptanceCriteria: Landing page renders without errors and is the default route
Form includes at least: App name, Description, Target users, Must-have features, Nice-to-have features
Submitting the form displays a readable summary of the entered information on the page
All user-facing text is in English

requirements.text: Persist the submitted app idea in the backend canister and allow fetching the latest submitted idea from the frontend (single latest record is sufficient).

quotes: Hello can you help me make a app

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes methods to save an app idea and to fetch the latest saved app idea
Frontend calls the backend to save the idea on submit and can load/display the latest saved idea after a refresh
If no idea has been saved yet, the UI shows an empty state message in English

requirements.text: Apply a coherent visual theme across the UI (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for an app-builder onboarding experience; avoid blue/purple as the primary palette.
acceptanceCriteria: UI uses a consistent palette, typography scale, and spacing rhythm across the landing page, form, and summary view
No custom edits are made to immutable UI component source paths; compose components instead

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).

Do not edit any frontend immutable paths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
nonGoals: Implementing a specific app domain (e.g., ecommerce, social network, game) beyond capturing and persisting the user’s idea.
Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
